## Notes

Only criterion 1 has member-facing code, and it is off in production: #753 added `post_series`, `page_posts.series_id`, the strict `series` input on `group.post_create` and the composer's repeat control, behind `NEXT_PUBLIC_SERIES_COMPOSER` (unset per #753, and #952 on 10-18 still says repeating posts are behind the switch [A]). #956 restyled its weekday chips as text. #753 is `review-skipped`; `Deploy health` is green on 685f5d1 and 546f086. Smoked is unknown: the flag hides the control.

Since 10-16, two neighbours built pieces of criteria 2 to 5 without building them: #963 (Maidu Park) has the unclaimed loader write a `post_series` and its next three dates as real `page_posts` rows for market Pages, idempotent and rolled weekly, for those Pages only; #952 (Remind me) computes a member series' dates from its weekdays at send time, DST-safe, because no rows exist [V market-days.ts, reminder-sender.ts, PR bodies]. A member's series still gets no occurrence rows, no three-month window, no de-duplication in `browse_feed`, and the metro has no timezone in code (#173). Daylight saving ends 2026-11-01.

Filed: none new. Open and covering: #841 (check criterion 1; every marker on it says `partial`), #593, #594, #595, #597, #600, #602, #603. `Gates: none`, no milestone, none `launch-blocking`.
